standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.anyflow: AnyFlow 管线（FM 一致性）。注意 AnyFlow 分支只接受 anima / newbie 两族；在其他训练类型上选它，后端会回落到 dp_dmd_turbo。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.anyflow: The AnyFlow pipeline (FM consistency). Note that the AnyFlow branch accepts only the anima and newbie families; choose it on another training type and the backend falls back to dp_dmd_turbo.

advanced.principle: dp_dmd_turbo=少步蒸馏；anyflow=AnyFlow 一致性蒸馏。

advanced_en.principle: dp_dmd_turbo = few-step distillation; anyflow = AnyFlow consistency distillation.
